Author: Stephen Booysen
Message:
feat(authservice): session and token hygiene (feature 23)

- Session tokens are no longer accepted from the query string by the portal
  guard, the data-plane API guard or the auth routes; dashboards use the
  httpOnly session cookie only and keep no token in localStorage.
- POST /services/authservice/api/session/handoff exchanges a session token
  for the cookie (SSO, extensions); GET /services/authservice/api/session
  reports the signed-in user (replaces the missing auth/check endpoint).
- Origin/Referer check refuses cross-site state-changing cookie requests.
- Idle timeouts (30 minutes for admins, 8 hours otherwise) and an absolute
  24-hour lifetime for token and cookie sessions; express-session rolling.
- Password and role changes revoke every session (sessionsValidAfter).
- Personal access tokens expire after 90 days by default; admins can list
  and revoke a user's tokens.
- Referrer-Policy: no-referrer on /services.

Closes review finding M-2.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
